title: Ethanol + water, NRTL: a distillate purity above the azeotrope
purpose: (e) A purity specification that no column can meet: ethanol at 0.95 mole fraction in the distillate, above the model's azeotrope at 101.325 kPa (fixture: B1-ethanol-water-nrtl, checks.azeotrope). Purity specifications come with milestone M4: until then the engine refuses the specification kind (unsupported); from M4 it refuses the value and names the azeotrope. Never a converged column.
method_choice: docs/METHOD_SELECTION.md rule 3: NRTL (default set), ideal-gas vapour.
